regime_context: The detector shows Big Banks as the dominant theme with high durability (0.74), full breadth, and extreme crowding. The rotation base is broad (69% eligible) but no single narrative dominates (absorption 0.36). emerging_watch: Base Metals as a potential leadership challenger: watch for rotation margin vs. Banks to narrow below 0.3 AND Base Metals’ durability_bar to rise above 0.6. Kill if margin widens above 0.8 or Banks’ durability_bar stays above 0.8 for 10 days — no confirmed handoff yet.

theses.subject: Big Banks
